retainedDeclarations: index.d.ts is the MIT-licensed Redux 5.0.1 public declaration contract, preserved byte-for-byte. LICENSE retains the upstream attribution. No upstream runtime is shipped.

implementation.basis: Independently written store with cached listener snapshots, own-property reducer assembly and iterative middleware composition.
implementation.targetScope: All nine Redux 5.0.1 runtime exports; the store, enhancer and middleware APIs used by @hello-pangea/dnd18.0.1.

changes: Prototype-named reducer and bound-action keys stay own properties without invoking inherited setters or inheriting slice state.
Listener membership changes invalidate a cached snapshot; reentrant dispatch preserves each dispatch's notification set.
Plain object checks use two prototype reads and do not access constructor getters.
Zero runtime dependencies, CJS/ESM exports and the original public TypeScript contract.
